model_claims.text: After applying this change, running isort twice on a file produces identical output (the second run does not modify the file).
model_claims.source_quote: With this branch both files stay the same on the second run.

model_claims.text: The grouping loop now skips a conflicting name instead of stopping at it, allowing names without a comment to be placed in the first statement.
model_claims.source_quote: Names without a comment all go into the first statement. The loop skips a conflicting name instead of stopping at it.

model_claims.text: Each later statement contains a single commented name, kept on one line when possible, so the comment remains attached to that name.
model_claims.source_quote: Each later statement holds a single commented name, on one line when it fits, so the comment stays with that name.

model_claims.text: Comments added by combine_as_imports to the first statement are considered during grouping because they ultimately appear there.
model_claims.source_quote: Comments that `combine_as_imports` adds to the first statement are taken into account while grouping, since they end up there anyway.

items.about: Test stability and grouping behavior with and without combine_as_imports

claims.text: After applying this change, running isort twice on a file produces identical output (the second run does not modify the file).
The grouping loop now skips a conflicting name instead of stopping at it, allowing names without a comment to be placed in the first statement.
Each later statement contains a single commented name, kept on one line when possible, so the comment remains attached to that name.
Comments added by combine_as_imports to the first statement are considered during grouping because they ultimately appear there.
With this branch, none of the files in the test set change on a second isort run (output is stable across runs).
The added regression test fails on the current main branch.
Reverting any single part of the change causes one of the regression test assertions to fail, showing each part is necessary.
The number of import blocks that still change on a second sort drops from 1,337 on main to 108 with this branch.
